services.name: Kayak Rentals

Choose from single kayaks, double kayaks, and fishing kayaks with rental options to suit your needs. We make it easy to book your kayak rental online. services.name: Jet Skis Rentals 1 Hour
services.desc: Know Before You Ride: $1,000 Security deposit hold per jet ski rented is required at the time of onboarding. Hold will be released after your reservation if there are no damages found to our skis. Arrival is required 30 Minutes before your reservation time. Being late to your onboarding may result in a reduction of time or a rebooking of your reservation to another day. Refunds are only valid 24 hours prior to your reservation. Must be 18+ to make reservations, Operators must be 16+ years old; passengers may be any age. We require a parent or guardian to be on premise if minors are riding without them. All drivers regardless of age must present a valid ID (passport, DL or State ID Card)

blurb: Guests can rent Hobie Mirage Drive fishing kayaks, jet skis, and stand-up paddleboards including the Mirage Eclipse. The business offers demos of kayaks at their Dana Point showroom on the water. Jet skis are kept on the water and ready to rent, with on-site repair services available.
